description: This file declares functions and classes related to capturing and processing stack traces, including retrieving stack frames and trace information, with support for context from signal handlers. It is part of the Abseil debugging library.

methods.name: GetStackFrames
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, and stores the results and sizes in provided buffers.

methods.name: GetStackFramesWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, with options for context and dropped frames.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Records program counter values for up to max_depth frames, skipping skip_count frames, returning only the trace without sizes.

methods.name: GetStackTraceWithContext
methods.description: Records program counter values from a signal handler context, similar to GetStackTrace but with context and dropped frames info.

methods.name: SetStackUnwinder
methods.description: Sets a custom unwinder function for stack trace retrieval.

methods.name: DefaultStackUnwinder
methods.description: Default implementation for unwinding stack frames, used if no custom unwinder is set.
